I confirmed it to Hollis in your DM. I told them that from now on, their cutoff for the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork on the Thistle renewal is 20 September.

I didn't save it to the workspace brain separately. The brain already records every direct message and shows it only to the member who sent it. The save tool had no clear way to keep a new entry private to Hollis, so a separate write could have exposed what they told me privately to other people.

I didn't share it anywhere else or take any other action, since Hollis said none was needed.
